purpose: One executable engineering contract for all current and future Powerhouse agents and chats, without creating a parallel delivery authority.

platform_roles.github: source, review, protected merge and exact candidate identity
platform_roles.netlify: web preview, immutable deploy evidence and production web runtime
platform_roles.supabase: database/schema/functions/runtime state through source-controlled migrations and configuration
platform_roles.notion: human-readable knowledge, audit and system-map projection; never deployed identity authority
platform_roles.buffer: social provider execution/readback evidence; never engineering source authority

engineering_rules: Prefer small coherent modules with explicit interfaces and ownership.
Prefer reusable helpers and reusable workflows over copy-paste families.
Tests must assert behavior or evidence, not incidental wording or implementation text.
A test is not a gate until CI demonstrably executes it.
Production schema and function behavior must remain reconstructable from source control.
No hidden magic score, threshold, authority or deployment rule may remain undocumented.
No new brain, registry, queue, calendar, analytics store or learning store when an existing canonical capability can be extended.
Documentation and learning writeback are release outputs, not optional follow-up.
